name: Horny Orc Alchemist 🧪🔞
source: Brew forbidden potions, run a seductive alchemy shop, and satisfy the desires of your most tempting customers. Discover their secrets, experiment with dangerous recipes, and watch things get hotter with every unexpected side effect. Some potions unlock more than magic.
translation: 熬制禁忌魔药，经营一家充满魅惑气息的炼金工坊，满足最诱人顾客们的隐秘欲求。发掘她们的秘密，大胆试验危险配方，亲眼见证每一次意想不到的副作用如何让场面变得愈发火辣失控——有些魔药所能解开的，可远不止魔法而已。
